description: The Coastal Zone Color Scanner (CZCS) on Nimbus-7, an ocean-colour scanner. The curves are the relative spectral responses of its four ocean-colour bands (443, 520, 550, 670 nm) as distributed by NASA's Ocean Biology DAAC.
facility_description: Nimbus-7, a NASA satellite that carried the Coastal Zone Color Scanner (CZCS).

licence.terms: "Mission data are released as soon as possible, and unrestricted mission software is developed openly." (NASA Science Mission Directorate, Scientific Information Policy page, linked as 'Data & Information Policy' from the OB.DAAC directory page that lists CZCS_RSRs.txt)
licence.scope: Agency-wide NASA SMD data policy linked from the site footer; the file itself states no terms.

notes: File header: responses 'taken from Figures 2-2, 2-3, 2-4, and 2-5 from volume 2 of the Ball Bros. Final Report F78-11 Revision A, May, 1979' (message from Howard Gordon), tabulated on a 1 nm grid; -999 samples dropped and each band scaled to peak 1. Pivots equal SVO's NIMBUS/CZCS records (band520, band670). DetectorType energy is assumed. The file holds only these four bands.
